subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should maintainers keep this as the combined Control UI/session tracker, or route structured reply metadata to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a replacement and final/no-output semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: Current main partially covers the UI affordance and generic runtime-context transport, but the permanent contract boundary spans Control UI, Gateway protocol, agent runtime context, and channel delivery semantics.

options.title: Split Across Existing Owners
options.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the structured reply contract, keep final/no-output semantics in the durable final-fallback issue, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface Control UI/session-output umbrella until both reply metadata and no-output UX are implemented together.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat the current Markdown quote UI as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback delivery contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Owners
recommendation.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for the structured reply contract, keep final/no-output semantics in the durable final-fallback issue, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest shared routing signal across the merged Control UI reply affordance and current Gateway/UI send boundaries.
